title: Hulls, linear equivalence, and weighted superelliptic codes
summary: The containment of the code of the meet $G\wedge A$ in the hull and the identity $G\vee A-D=K-G\wedge A$ exchanging meet and join are known; imposing that $G\wedge A$ be principal constructs algebraic geometry codes with one-dimensional hull. We turn that construction into a measurement. For arbitrary divisors $G$ and $A$ we compute $C_L(D,G)\cap C_L(D,A)$ exactly: it is the code of the meet together with an excess $\varepsilon(G,A)$, canonically their quotient and a subquotient of $H^1(\mathcal O(G\wedge A))$.
